description.value: Giant Richmond is an authorized Giant brand bicycle dealership in Richmond, BC, offering a broad selection of road, mountain, gravel, and electric bikes alongside a full-service workshop with multiple service tiers. The shop is notably inclusive, with bilingual English and Chinese signage throughout, and fosters a local riding community through two recurring weekly group rides. Touring cyclists will find a well-stocked accessories floor including panniers, racks, and fenders, plus professional mechanical support.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 11m; rack at 17m; stands at 30m; rack at 72m; rack at 80m; rack at 90m; rack (covered) at 97m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at giantrichmond.com is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact data. The service page details a comprehensive workshop (three tune-up tiers covering derailleur adjustment, brake bleed, wheel truing, headset service), confirming staff capability for urgent mechanicals. The navigation menu explicitly includes 'Rental/出租' confirming rentals; the accessories section lists Bags & Panniers, Racks, and Fenders as stocked items; and the front page advertises two weekly shop-organized group rides.
concerns: OSM name is 'Giant' but the business consistently identifies itself as 'Giant Richmond' on its website and in all contact details; the bare OSM name may cause confusion with the global Giant brand.
OSM rendered address omits unit number and postal code; website confirms the full address as '#125 6833 Buswell Street V6Y 0L3 Richmond' — all other contact details match.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate authorized Giant dealership with a full workshop, rental program, touring accessories, and community group rides — clear and direct value for touring cyclists passing through Richmond.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Website accessories section explicitly lists Bags & Panniers, Racks, and Fenders under Bike Gear Accessories

Bike rentals.detail: 'Rental/出租' appears as a top-level navigation item on the website, indicating rental services are offered

Guided rides.detail: Front page lists two shop-organized recurring rides: 'LIV Richmond Social Ride for New Cyclists — Weekly Ride Every Tuesday' and 'Giant Richmond Weekly Group Rides — Weekly on Wednesdays, Richmond, BC'

wow_evidence: authorized Giant brand bicycle dealership... full workshop... Bags & Panniers, Racks, and Fenders
